root_cause_label: Conservative Data Subsampling Preventing Accuracy Target
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent irreversibly committed to training on small balanced subsets (20k-40k out of 650k samples) due to a false premise about timeout risk, which combined with a NumPy-FastText incompatibility environment obstacle, prevented it from reaching the 0.62 accuracy target before it submitted a failing model.
t_err_evidence: At step 19 the agent decides to create small training subsets (50k out of 650k, then scaled down to 20k) to avoid timeouts, without empirically verifying that smaller subsets can achieve the 0.62 accuracy threshold. The script train_fasttext_small.py samples 50000 training examples and 5000 test examples from the 650k/10k dataset. This conservative subsampling strategy was never revisited even after the accuracy ceiling became apparent.
t_commit_evidence: At step 44 the agent first successfully evaluates the model (after applying a NumPy monkeypatch), revealing accuracy of 0.567 on a 20k-sample trained model. After this point the agent only attempts narrow hyperparameter variations on similarly-sized subsets (20k-50k samples), and all subsequent runs produce accuracy between 0.476-0.571. The agent never attempts training on the full 650k dataset, locking in the failure.
t_surface_evidence: Step 44 output explicitly shows: 'Accuracy: 0.5670 (target: >= 0.62), Model needs tuning but is saved at /app/model.bin'. This is the first step with a real observable accuracy signal confirming the model fails to meet the 0.62 threshold.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed at step 19 that the full 650k training dataset would cause timeout or memory issues, so it adopted small balanced subsets without verifying that these subsets could achieve the required 0.62 accuracy. This false premise about scale constraints caused all subsequent training attempts to use only 3-8% of the available training data.
forewarning_evidence: Step 33 shows the NumPy-FastText incompatibility causing a prediction error (ValueError: Unable to avoid copy while creating an array as requested), and the training loss of 0.609962 on only 20k samples suggests the model may be undertrained. Steps 34-43 repeatedly fail to properly fix the NumPy issue, reporting accuracy of 0.0000 due to prediction errors, which is a signal that the evaluation pipeline is broken.
